transport.input: one JSON object on stdin, maximum 1 MiB
transport.failure: non-zero exit with ok=false and error.code

items patch.payload_semantics: full target snapshot for all managed fields, not a partial patch

unmanaged items patch.payload_semantics: full target snapshot for title/due/priority or title/location/time/alarms; omitted native fields are preserved by the bridge

search_window.end_at: RFC 3339 timestamp with explicit offset; exclusive upper bound

one_of.at: RFC 3339 minute-precision timestamp with explicit offset

one_of.start_at: RFC 3339 minute-precision timestamp with explicit offset
one_of.end_at: RFC 3339 minute-precision timestamp with explicit offset

event_alarm.minutes_before: integer 0..10080; display-relative only; maximum five unique alarms

shapes.dry_run: required boolean on every mutation; true for preview and false only with preview_hash for execute

event_payload.title: 1..500 characters, no line breaks
event_payload.location: non-empty string without NUL, or null; use null for no location

mutation_protocol.preview: dry_run=true returns preview_hash and does not create a journal
mutation_protocol.event_store_epoch: every successful mutation preview/preflight/result must include a non-empty event_store_id; missing stops before mutation; a changed preflight invalidates scopes/locators before actual, and a changed successful actual result remains outcome_unknown without rebuilding locators
mutation_protocol.actual_store_handshake: expected_event_store_id is an executor-owned internal transport field, forbidden in public requests and excluded from preview intent; the executor injects the fresh-preflight epoch into the actual bridge request and Swift verifies it again immediately before any native effect
mutation_protocol.operation_epoch: every operation that enters in_flight retains its fresh-preflight event_store_id; unresolved operations cannot reconcile across epochs, and terminal success replay is successful only while the current state remains in that epoch
mutation_protocol.bridge_exit_consistency: a nonzero bridge exit can never propagate ok=true; the executor normalizes it to ok=false and supplies bridge_protocol_error when the bridge omitted an error
mutation_protocol.notes_preservation: mutations that retain or compose notes compare exact expected notes against native readback in Swift memory; raw notes are never returned or persisted by the executor
mutation_protocol.execute: same public request with dry_run=false and preview_hash; executor checkpoints prepared, repeats fresh dry-run, checkpoints in_flight, injects the internal expected_event_store_id, invokes EventKit, reads back, then checkpoints terminal
mutation_protocol.prepared_zero_match: safe to perform the first invocation because in_flight has not been checkpointed
mutation_protocol.in_flight_or_outcome_unknown: never replay automatically; operations reconcile re-submits the original request, verifies its journal hash, performs bounded reads itself, and terminalizes only a proven verified_local/not_applied/conflict result from an ok=true read envelope whose non-empty event_store_id matches the journal; every nonzero or ok=false read remains outcome_unknown
mutation_protocol.reconcile_read_shapes: successful items find permits only count=0 with null/absent item or count=1 with one item object; successful items get must return the exact requested item_id; successful containers list must return an array of objects; malformed success remains outcome_unknown
mutation_protocol.manual_resolution: operations resolve can close prepared as not_applied; after in_flight it may only record conflict or explicit abandon_unknown, never self-reported success/not_applied
mutation_protocol.lock_scope: owner-only state lock spans checkpoint, child EventKit operation, readback response, and terminal checkpoint

state.legacy_v1_policy: fail closed; never auto-migrate or replay because pre-first-cut unresolved operations do not carry a trustworthy EventKit epoch
state.privacy: IDs, states, timestamps, hashes and fingerprints only; no titles, notes, locations, attendees, account names or emails

unsupported: subscribed, immutable or delegated container mutation
direct invocation of the internal bridge runner or app; bundled static tokens are accidental-misuse guards, not same-user authentication
AppleScript, UI automation, iCloud.com or CalDAV fallback
